title: eSpring基金经理ChristinaWoon：中国人工智能生态扩张
speaker: Christina Woon

segments.en: There are other parts within the market that could be interesting as well, or you might see dislocations. The material sector has come off quite a lot in the past month too, but when you think about fundamentals there are some of the numbers that some companies have also been delivering.
segments.zh: 市场其他部分也可能有趣，或者你会看到错位。材料板块过去一个月也大幅回调，但考虑到基本面，一些公司公布的数据依然强劲。

segments.en: These continue to be quite strong, so that's the way that I would look at things at this point, with volatility where there are really dislocations in certain sectors that could be interesting, or some overlook sectors that could be interesting as well.
segments.zh: 这些数据依然强劲，所以这就是我目前看待市场的方式：在波动中，某些板块出现错位可能带来机会，或者一些被忽视的板块也可能有趣。

segments.en: Is there still overlook bits of the Chinese AI trade, especially when it comes to the boarding out beyond hardware as well?
segments.zh: 中国AI交易中是否还有被忽视的部分，尤其是在硬件之外的领域？

segments.en: Yeah, I think that's absolutely right. You've been spot on when you think about which parts in China have actually been holding up quite well. The China tech trade has actually been pretty strong, and we've seen really, really strong share price funds within that space, but similar to what you see in Taiwan, the China ecosystem is one that's continuing to build out.
segments.zh: 是的，完全正确。你说得很准，中国哪些板块表现良好。中国科技交易实际上相当强劲，我们看到该领域股价表现非常强劲，但类似于台湾，中国的生态系统正在持续扩张。
